No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result FG’s ₦50,000 Support: Step-by-Step Guide For OPay Users To Access The Funds by Ezra Ukanwa 32 minutes ago in How-to , Business , News Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram The federal government has commenced the disbursement of ₦50,000 monthly cash support to selected vulnerable Nigerians under its National Emergency Relief and Stabilisation Intervention (NERSI).
The programme, launched on October 30, 2026, is designed to provide financial assistance to poor and vulnerable households struggling with the rising cost of living and inflation.
The Minister of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Reduction, Dr Bernard Doro, announced that the intervention would provide direct financial support to eligible beneficiaries through approved digital financial service providers.
ALSO READ: ActionAid Seeks Transparency In FG’s N50,000 Cash Support Scheme
One of the approved payment providers is OPay, which has announced a process through which selected beneficiaries can check their eligibility and accept the payment.
For Nigerians using OPay, here is how to check eligibility and access the ₦50,000 support.
1. Dial the USSD code: Open your phone dialler and dial *955*20# using the phone number linked to your OPay account.
2. Follow the instructions: Select the appropriate option and follow the prompts to check your eligibility and accept the support.
3. Use the OPay application: Alternatively, log in to your OPay application and check the homepage for a notification indicating that you have been selected.
4. Accept the support: If selected, follow the instructions provided to give your consent and complete the process.
5. Receive your payment: Once the process is completed, the ₦50,000 support will be credited to your designated mobile wallet.
According to the Federal Government’s NERSI programme guidelines, beneficiaries are selected from verified national identity records and the National Social Register.
The intervention targets poor and vulnerable households across Nigeria’s six geopolitical zones.
However, the government says beneficiaries cannot independently apply or pay to be included on the list. Selection is based on verified records and screening processes.
Payments are also being made in phases, meaning eligible Nigerians may not receive notifications at the same time.
Yes. The Federal Government says beneficiaries are not required to pay any registration, processing or activation fees to receive the money.
The government has also warned Nigerians against fraudsters who may demand money or personal information under the guise of facilitating the payment.
Beneficiaries are advised not to disclose their ATM PIN, one-time password (OTP) or other confidential banking details to anyone.
For enquiries or complaints about the programme, Nigerians can contact the official NERSI helpline on 0700-022-2222.
The ₦50,000 support is a government grant and does not have to be repaid.
